HW1 DE Analysis

Author

Justė Tamulionytė

Uploading and cleaning files

library(readr)
count_table <- read_table("count_table.txt", 
    skip = 1)
gene_types <- read_table("gene_types.tsv", 
    col_names = FALSE)
colnames(gene_types) <- c("Gene_ID", "Gene_name", "Gene_type")
count_table_clean <- count_table[, -c(2:6)]
colnames(count_table_clean) <- c("Gene_ID", "SRR11647687", "SRR11647690", "SRR11647693", "SRR11647697", "SRR11647700", "SRR11647703")
combined_table <- merge(gene_types, count_table_clean, by = "Gene_ID")
protein_coding <- combined_table[combined_table$Gene_type == "protein_coding", ]
counts_protein_coding <- protein_coding[, -c(2,3)]
rownames(counts_protein_coding) <- counts_protein_coding$Gene_ID
counts_protein_coding <- counts_protein_coding[, -1]
library(readxl)
coldata_BDA <- read_xlsx("coldata_BDA.xlsx")
coldata_BDA <- as.data.frame(coldata_BDA)
rownames(coldata_BDA) <- coldata_BDA$Sample
coldata_BDA$Type <- as.factor(coldata_BDA$Type)

DESeq2, shrinkage

library(DESeq2)

dds_BDA <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_protein_coding,
  colData = coldata_BDA,
  design = ~ Type
)

dds_BDA$Type <- relevel(dds_BDA$Type, ref = "non_tumor")

keep <- rowSums(counts(dds_BDA)) >= 10
dds_BDA <- dds_BDA[keep, ]
cat("Genes remaining after low-count filter:", nrow(dds_BDA), "\n")
Genes remaining after low-count filter: 17053 
dds_BDA <- DESeq(dds_BDA)
res_BDA <- results(dds_BDA, contrast = c("Type","tumor","non_tumor"), alpha = 0.05)
summary(res_BDA)

out of 17053 with nonzero total read count
adjusted p-value < 0.05
LFC > 0 (up)       : 450, 2.6%
LFC < 0 (down)     : 539, 3.2%
outliers [1]       : 214, 1.3%
low counts [2]     : 992, 5.8%
(mean count < 5)
[1] see 'cooksCutoff' argument of ?results
[2] see 'independentFiltering' argument of ?results
res_BDA_shrunk <- lfcShrink(dds_BDA, coef = "Type_tumor_vs_non_tumor", type = "apeglm")

Fold change table

library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
res_BDA_df <- res_BDA_shrunk |>
  as.data.frame() |>
  rownames_to_column("gene") |>
  arrange(padj) |>
  mutate(
    significance = case_when(
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange >  1 ~ "Up",
      padj < 0.05 & log2FoldChange < -1 ~ "Down",
      TRUE ~ "NS"  # Not Significant
    ),
    significance = factor(significance, levels = c("Up", "Down", "NS"))
  )
table(res_BDA_df$significance)

   Up  Down    NS 
  389   473 16191

Save two list of differentially expressed genes: one without fold change threshold and one with fold change threshold.

deg_no_fc <- res_BDA_df %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05)
write.csv(deg_no_fc, "DEG_no_fold_change.csv", row.names = FALSE)
deg_fc <- res_BDA_df %>%
  filter(padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
write.csv(deg_fc, "DEG_with_fold_change.csv", row.names = FALSE)
gsea_list <- res_BDA_df %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange) %>%
  dplyr::arrange(desc(log2FoldChange))
write.table(gsea_list,
            "gsea_ranked_genes.txt",
            sep="\t",
            quote=FALSE,
            row.names=FALSE)

Plots

  1. Identify total number of reads per sample (using count data) and number of detected genes. Discuss if anything looks abnormal and identify lowest-quality sample.
reads_per_sample <- colSums(count_table_clean[, -1])
genes_detected <- colSums(count_table_clean[, -1] > 0)
qc_table <- data.frame(
  Sample = colnames(count_table_clean[, -1]),
  Total_reads = reads_per_sample,
  Detected_genes = genes_detected
)

qc_table
                 Sample Total_reads Detected_genes
SRR11647687 SRR11647687    29084483          37183
SRR11647690 SRR11647690    23135386          33794
SRR11647693 SRR11647693    24518369          32017
SRR11647697 SRR11647697    22955980          29922
SRR11647700 SRR11647700    22924594          32347
SRR11647703 SRR11647703    26050317          33822
library(ggplot2)
library(tidyr)

qc_table_long <- qc_table |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(Total_reads, Detected_genes),
    names_to = "Metric",
    values_to = "Value"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    log_value = log2(Value + 1)
  )

qc_table_long |>
  dplyr::filter(Metric == "Total_reads") |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = Sample, y = Value)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#00BFC4") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Total Reads per Sample",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Total Reads"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )
qc_table_long |>
  dplyr::filter(Metric == "Detected_genes") |>
  ggplot2::ggplot(ggplot2::aes(x = Sample, y = Value)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = "#F8766D") +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Detected Genes per Sample",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Number of Genes"
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1)
  )
  1. Provide a PCA plot and explain what you see in the PCA. 
dds_BDA_all <- DESeqDataSetFromMatrix(
  countData = counts_protein_coding[rowSums(counts_protein_coding) >= 10, ],
  colData = coldata_BDA,
  design = ~ Type
)

vst_BDA_all <- vst(dds_BDA_all, blind = FALSE)
norm_counts_BDA <- assay(vst_BDA_all)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
pcaData <- plotPCA(vst_BDA_all, intgroup = "Type", returnData=TRUE)
percentVar <- round(100 * attr(pcaData, "percentVar"))

ggplot(pcaData, aes(PC1, PC2, color = Type, label = name)) +
  geom_point(size = 4) +
  geom_text_repel(size = 3.5) +
  xlab(paste0("PC1: ", percentVar[1], "% variance")) +
  ylab(paste0("PC2: ", percentVar[2], "% variance")) +
  labs(color = "Type") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1))
  1. Make a correlation plot that shows pearson correlation (using gene level data) between individual samples. Provide a plot as well as an explanation of what the plot tells. 
library(pheatmap)
# Calculate pairwise Pearson correlations on VST counts
cor_mat  <- cor(norm_counts_BDA, method = "pearson")

# Annotation for the heatmap
anno_df <- coldata_BDA |>
  dplyr::select(Type)

# Color palette
anno_colors <- list(
  Type = c(
    tumor = "#00BFC4",
    non_tumor = "#F8766D"
  )
)

pheatmap(
  cor_mat,
  annotation_col = anno_df,
  annotation_row = anno_df,
  annotation_colors = anno_colors,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "#2166AC"))(50),
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Sample-to-Sample Pearson Correlation",
  fontsize = 10
)

  1. Provide a volcano plot as well as an explanation of what you got.
volcano_df <- res_BDA_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  mutate(negLog10Padj = -log10(padj))

top_labels <- volcano_df %>%
  filter(significance != "NS") %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  slice_head(n = 10)

ggplot(volcano_df, aes(x = log2FoldChange, y = negLog10Padj, color = significance)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.6, size = 2) +
  geom_vline(xintercept = c(-1, 1), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_hline(yintercept = -log10(0.05), linetype = "dashed", color = "gray50") +
  geom_text_repel(
    data = top_labels,
    aes(label = gene),
    size = 3,
    max.overlaps = 100,
    box.padding = 0.3
  ) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Up" = "#F8766D", "Down" = "#619CFF", "NS" = "grey70")) +
  labs(
    title = "Volcano Plot — tumor vs non-tumor",
    subtitle = "padj < 0.05 and |log2FC| > 1 threshold shown as dashed lines",
    x = "log2 Fold Change",
    y = "-log10(adjusted p-value)",
    color = "Direction"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    panel.border = element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold")
  )

  1. Create/provide heatmap that would show your DEG results (TOP genes only).
top_genes <- res_BDA_df %>%
  filter(!is.na(padj)) %>%
  arrange(padj) %>%
  head(50) %>%
  pull(gene)

samples_tumor_nontumor <- coldata_BDA %>%
  filter(Type %in% c("tumor", "non_tumor")) %>%
  pull(Sample)

vst_subset <- norm_counts_BDA[top_genes, samples_tumor_nontumor]

vst_z <- t(scale(t(vst_subset)))

anno_subset <- coldata_BDA %>%
  filter(Sample %in% samples_tumor_nontumor) %>%
  dplyr::select(Type)


library(RColorBrewer)
pheatmap(
  vst_z,
  annotation_col  = anno_subset,
  annotation_colors = list(treatment = anno_colors$Type[c("tumor", "non_tumor")]),
  color = colorRampPalette(rev(brewer.pal(11, "RdBu")))(50),
  cluster_rows = TRUE,
  cluster_cols = TRUE,
  show_rownames = TRUE,
  fontsize_row = 8,
  border_color = NA,
  main = "Top 50 DE Genes — Tumor vs. Non-tumor (Z-scored VST)"
)

  1. Using statistically significant differential expression genes, perform GO over-representation analysis (for all terms), provide a visualisation and describe what you got.
sig_de <- res_BDA_df |>
  filter(padj < 0.05 & abs(log2FoldChange) > 1)
library(stringr)
sig_de$gene <- str_remove(sig_de$gene, "\\..*")

sig_de_genes <- sig_de$gene
sig_de_genes <- unique(sig_de_genes[!is.na(sig_de_genes)])
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)

ego_all <- enrichGO(
  gene          = sig_de_genes,
  OrgDb         = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType       = "ENSEMBL",
  ont           = "ALL",
  pAdjustMethod = "BH",
  pvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  qvalueCutoff  = 0.05,
  readable      = TRUE
)
dotplot(ego_all, showCategory = 5, split = "ONTOLOGY") + facet_grid(ONTOLOGY ~ ., scale = "free") +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("GO ORA for all terms")
barplot(ego_all, showCategory = 10) +
  ggplot2::ggtitle("GO ORA Barplot")

  1. Using your list of genes, perform GSEA analysis over GO and MSIGdb. Provide a visualisation and describe what you got.
library(dplyr)
library(tibble)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(msigdbr)
library(BiocParallel)

# išjungia parallel backend, kad nebūtų serialize/data,node$con klaidos
BiocParallel::register(BiocParallel::SerialParam())

# paruošiam geneList GSEA analizei
gsea_geneList <- res_BDA_df %>%
  dplyr::mutate(gene = sub("\\..*", "", gene)) %>%   # pašalina ENSEMBL versijas po taško
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(gene), !is.na(log2FoldChange)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct(gene, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
  dplyr::select(gene, log2FoldChange) %>%
  tibble::deframe() %>%
  sort(decreasing = TRUE)

# papildomi patikrinimai
gsea_geneList <- gsea_geneList[!is.na(names(gsea_geneList))]
gsea_geneList <- gsea_geneList[!duplicated(names(gsea_geneList))]
gsea_geneList <- sort(gsea_geneList, decreasing = TRUE)

# GO GSEA
gsea_go <- clusterProfiler::gseGO(
  geneList = gsea_geneList,
  OrgDb = org.Hs.eg.db,
  keyType = "ENSEMBL",
  ont = "ALL",
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  verbose = FALSE
)

# MSigDB Hallmark
msig_h <- msigdbr::msigdbr(species = "Homo sapiens", category = "H") %>%
  dplyr::select(gs_name, ensembl_gene) %>%
  dplyr::filter(!is.na(ensembl_gene)) %>%
  dplyr::distinct()

gsea_hallmark <- clusterProfiler::GSEA(
  geneList = gsea_geneList,
  TERM2GENE = msig_h,
  pvalueCutoff = 0.05,
  verbose = FALSE
)
gseaplot2(gsea_go, geneSetID = 1:4, title = "GSEA Enrichment - Top GO Terms")
gseaplot2(gsea_hallmark, geneSetID = 1:4, title = "GSEA Enrichment - Top Hallmark Pathways")
ridgeplot(gsea_go, showCategory = 10) +
  labs(title = "GSEA GO – distribution of Log2FC for Top Pathways")
ridgeplot(gsea_hallmark, showCategory = 10) +
  labs(title = "GSEA Hallmark – distribution of Log2FC for Top Pathways")
dotplot(gsea_go, showCategory = 10)
dotplot(gsea_hallmark, showCategory = 10)

Mapping rate plot

library(tidyverse)

datalentele <- data.frame(
  Sample = c("SRR11647687", "SRR11647690", "SRR11647693",
             "SRR11647697", "SRR11647700", "SRR11647703"),
  aligned_concordantly_exactly_1_time   = c(90.86, 89.55, 90.34, 89.36, 83.51, 90.52),
  aligned_concordantly_more_than_1_time = c(3.58, 3.30, 3.72, 2.68, 10.59, 3.81)
)

data_long <- datalentele |>
  tidyr::pivot_longer(
    cols = c(
      aligned_concordantly_exactly_1_time,
      aligned_concordantly_more_than_1_time
    ),
    names_to = "Mapping_Type",
    values_to = "Percentage"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    Mapping_Type = factor(
      Mapping_Type,
      levels = c(
        "aligned_concordantly_exactly_1_time",
        "aligned_concordantly_more_than_1_time"
      )
    )
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(Sample) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    pos = cumsum(Percentage) - Percentage / 2
  ) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
ggplot2::ggplot(data_long, ggplot2::aes(x = Sample, y = Percentage, fill = Mapping_Type)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col() +
  ggplot2::labs(
    title = "Mapping Rate",
    x = "Sample",
    y = "Percentage of Reads (%)",
    fill = "Mapping Type"
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_manual(
    values = c(
      "aligned_concordantly_exactly_1_time" = "#00BFC4",
      "aligned_concordantly_more_than_1_time" = "#F8766D"
    ),
    labels = c(
      "aligned_concordantly_exactly_1_time" = "Exactly 1 time",
      "aligned_concordantly_more_than_1_time" = "More than 1 time"
    )
  ) +
  ggplot2::scale_y_continuous(
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 25),
    expand = c(0, 0)  # removes empty space at bottom
  ) +
  ggplot2::theme_minimal() +
  ggplot2::theme(
    axis.text.x = ggplot2::element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1),
    panel.border = ggplot2::element_rect(color = "black", fill = NA, linewidth = 1),
    plot.title = ggplot2::element_text(face = "bold")
  )
